# NextGen Lead Generator

> AI-powered Google Maps scraper created by Muhammad Affaf to find high-intent clients for Web Development, Marketing and Power BI / Fabric agencies.

## Summary
NextGen Lead Generator is a Triple Lead System developed by Muhammad Affaf from NextGen Analytics, Karachi, Pakistan. It helps agencies find high-intent clients on Google Maps across 195 countries. Built with Python, Playwright, Flask, Pandas, and Streamlit.

## Official Links
- [Landing Page](https://nextgenanalytics.cloud-ip.cc/nextgen-lead-generator/): Official documentation, features, how it works, niches and FAQ
- [Live App Demo](https://nextgen-lead-generator-nxp2zwykt8btyyvsutv42a.streamlit.app/): Working Streamlit app to search any niche and location
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/affaf12/nextgen-lead-generator): Open source codebase

## Features
- Web Development leads (businesses with no website) - Ticket $300-$800
- Marketing leads (businesses with low ratings) - Ticket $400-$1000/mo
- Power BI / Fabric leads (100+ reviews but no dashboard) - Ticket $950+ HIGH TICKET
- Triple System with Stop Button support
